text:
tanya_s: FYI pre-merge SAST flagged a risky deserialization in auth-proxy (PR #2319). tagging sec for quick triage.
ryan_ops: can you paste the code snippet and where it gets input from? vendor or our code?
tanya_s: ```java
// auth-proxy/AuthCookie.java:47
Object obj = new ObjectInputStream(new ByteArrayInputStream(payload)).readObject();
```
payload comes from the client cookie.
dev_jordan: that's our file. risky pattern. payload contains a base64 blob that decodes to JSON like {"kms_meta":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444:key/ef01","cipher":"..."} — not sure if we ever call Decrypt here.
secbot: Keystore-Service: last Decrypt for arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444:key/ef01 @4337651222 (actor=svc-auth)
oncall_sam: I'm running CloudTrail/KMS queries now. searching for Decrypt events where sourceIp != our VPC egress.
ryan_ops: svc-auth still has an old policy granting "kms:Decrypt" on "*" from pre-prod days. we should scope it to the specific key and add conditions.
tanya_s: short-term mitigation: stop raw deserialization, add allowlist for expected classes, and validate envelope before any crypto ops. I'll coordinate a small PR.
dev_jordan: I'll open a hotfix to replace ObjectInputStream with parsing the envelope into a POJO and refuse unknown payloads. will include unit tests.
lina_qa: I'll add a DAST regression that sends a crafted cookie payload and asserts it's rejected. put the test in nightly and run against canary after deploy.
oncall_sam: quick update: CloudTrail shows 5 Decrypt calls by svc-auth yesterday where requestIp != our VPC. collecting logs into an evidence bundle now.
ryan_ops: action: I'll remove the broad KMS Decrypt from svc-auth in staging tonight and prepare a narrow IAM policy for prod. will post diffs.
secbot: Audit ticket created: S-2026-215 assigned to ryan_ops, dev_jordan, oncall_sam for RBAC + evidence capture.
dev_jordan: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/auth-proxy/pull/2350 — sanitize + allowlist + tests.
tanya_s: recommend also updating the KMS key policy to restrict principals and add a SourceVpc/SourceIp condition.
oncall_sam: setting incident page severity to P2 while we confirm impact. if we see external decrypts of sensitive ciphertexts -> escalate.
lina_qa: running DAST probe branch `dast/auth-cookie-sanitize`. will post results in 10m.
deploy-bot: auth-proxy v1.8.12 deployed to canary @4337659800 (author=dev_jordan)
lina_qa: canary DAST shows the crafted cookie gets a 400 and payload is rejected. good sign.
ryan_ops: IAM diff (staging): - "kms:Decrypt": "*"  -> + "kms:Decrypt": ["arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:444:key/ef01"] with Condition {"StringEquals": {"aws:SourceVpc": "vpc-0a1b2c3d"}}
tanya_s: recap/action list: (1) merge hotfix to stop unsafe deserialization (dev_jordan) (2) roll narrow RBAC for svc-auth (ryan_ops) (3) decide on key rotation + schedule (security/infra) (4) add audit alert for Decrypts from non-VPC IPs (oncall_sam) (5) preserve evidence bundle and notify privacy if any exfiltration suspected.
oncall_sam: evidence being preserved: CloudTrail events, KMS logs, pod stderr/stdout, and raw cookie payloads (redacted) -> s3://sec-evidence/4337654321/
dev_jordan: merging the hotfix now. thanks for quick sync.
secbot: Audit: S-2026-215 updated with RBAC diff and evidence link.
tanya_s: I'll copy this thread into the incident workspace and ping legal if key rotation hits data-retention/privacy thresholds. thanks team.
